title: PaleoLib
description: A simple mod to provide the basis for Paleontology in Minecraft.
body:
This mod is meant to be a base for paleontology in Minecraft, meant for other mods to build upon the basic functionality it adds.


It adds a suspicious version of all Minecraft stones, and a new chisel tool to use on them, similarly to how the brush is used in the suspicious sand and gravel.


The new suspicious blocks don't generate naturally, and the chisel tool is made similar to how the brush is crafted, a stick, a copper ingot, and an iron ingot, in a vertical line.
